step1_figure.circuit_type: VCO Tuning / Bias Circuit for Current-Starved VCO
step1_figure.description: Figure 19.25 (referenced and discussed on page 574) shows a linear voltage-to-current converter and self-biased differential amplifier used to generate the VCO bias control voltage Vrbias from the control voltage Vindel. It regulates node n2 against Vref (500 mV) via negative feedback through M7.

id_mref.description: Reference tuning current generated by Mref degenerated by source resistor R1

source.reference: Fig 19.25 discussion and CMOSedu simulation commands

equation.explanation: Mref acts as a source follower driving resistor R1 (10k), establishing a linear reference current proportional to the control voltage Vindel above threshold.
equation.assumptions: Mref is operating in saturation; VGS,mref ≈ Vthn + Vov ≈ 0.52 V at Vindel = 0.8 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: At Vindel = 0.8 V, with Vthn = 0.42 V and (W/L)ref = 5u/0.5u = 10: V_P001 ≈ Vindel - Vthn - sqrt(2*Id / (un*Cox*10)). For R1 = 10 kΩ, solving V_P001/10k = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.8 - V_P001 - 0.42)^2 gives V_P001 ≈ 0.26 V, hence Id(Mref) ≈ 0.26 V / 10 kΩ = 26 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by Vindel sweep from 0.3V to 0.8V over resistor R1 = 10 kΩ.

v_n2_regulated.description: Regulated voltage at feedback node n2 tracking Vref

equation.explanation: The differential error amplifier compares V(n2) with Vref (500 mV) and drives M7 to close the negative feedback loop, forcing V(n2) ≈ Vref.
equation.assumptions: High open-loop gain of the error amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vref is fixed at 0.500 V. With an op-amp open-loop gain AOL ≈ 30-40 dB, the tracking offset is under 15 mV: V(n2) ≈ 0.500 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High-gain negative feedback forces node n2 to track Vref = 500 mV.

vrbias.description: Generated bias control voltage Vrbias to control VCO current-starved sinks

equation.explanation: The current mirrored from M5 through M8 (minus the current sunk by diode M10) must be sunk by M7, setting its gate voltage Vrbias.
equation.assumptions: M7 operates in saturation; I8 ≈ Id(Mref) ≈ 26 uA; I_D10 ≈ 3.5 uA at V(n2) = 0.5 V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard NMOS saturation gate overdrive above Vth = 0.42 V.

opamp_open_loop_gain.description: Small-signal open-loop DC voltage gain of the differential error amplifier (M1-M4, M6)

equation.explanation: Gain of the single-stage PMOS input differential amplifier with NMOS active current mirror load.
equation.assumptions: PMOS diff pair M3-M4 and mirror load M1-M2 in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With lambda_n = lambda_p = 0.1 V^-1 and Vov_pair ≈ 0.2 V: A_OL = 2 / (0.2 * 0.2) = 50 V/V. In dB: 20 * log10(50) ≈ 34.0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical single-stage differential operational amplifier gain in 180nm CMOS.

opamp_unity_gain_frequency.description: Unity-gain bandwidth of the error amplifier

equation.explanation: The gain-bandwidth product is set by the transconductance of input pair M3-M4 and parasitic/load capacitance at node Vrbias.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole at output node Vrbias with parasitic load capacitance CL ≈ 50 fF.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High bandwidth due to sub-picofarad on-chip parasitic loading.

supply_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of regulated node Vrbias to supply voltage variations (dVrbias/dVDD)

source.reference: Page 574 discussion on VCO power supply noise

equation.explanation: Page 574 highlights: 'The current-starved VCO\'s output frequency is not very stable with changes in VDD.' The sensitivity of Vrbias to VDD determines supply-induced frequency drift.
equation.assumptions: VDD swept from 1.6V to 2.0V around nominal 1.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to channel-length modulation (lambda ≈ 0.1/V) in M5/M8 and the op-amp tail source M6, Vrbias shifts by approximately 15 mV per 200 mV change in VDD, yielding S_VDD ≈ 0.075 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite output resistance of PMOS mirror and tail sources creates moderate supply sensitivity.

power.description: Total quiescent power consumption of the bias and tuning circuit

equation.explanation: Total static DC power dissipated by the reference generation branch, the mirrored load branch, and the error amplifier stage.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V, nominal bias currents I_ref ≈ 26 uA, I_8 ≈ 26 uA, I_tail(M6) ≈ 25 uA.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current IDD = I_ref + I_8 + I_tail ≈ 26 uA + 26 uA + 25 uA ≈ 77 uA. P_DC = 1.8 V * 77 uA ≈ 138.6 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of all DC branch currents multiplied by 1.8 V.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig 19.25 VCO bias generator measuring reference current, node regulation, bias output voltage, op-amp AC response, supply sensitivity, and DC power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Baker Fig 19.25 VCO Tuning and Bias Scheme
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized transistor sizes
.param W_xm1=2u   L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=2u   L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=4u   L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=4u   L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=4u   L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=8u   L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=2u   L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=4u   L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=4u   L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=2u  L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xmref=5u L_xmref=0.5u

* DUT Instance (direct netlist)
xm1 N004 N004 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
Vindel Vindel 0 dc 0.8
VDD VDD 0 dc 1.8
xm3 N004 n2_ac N003 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 Vrbias Vref N003 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm2 Vrbias N004 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm5 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm7 n2 Vrbias 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm6 N003 N004 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xmref N001 Vindel P001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmref} l={L_xmref}
R1 P001 0 10000.0
VREF VREF 0 dc 500mV
xm8 N002 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 n2 0 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 n2 n2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}

* Small AC coupling for open-loop AC analysis
Vac n2_ac n2 dc 0 ac 1
Cload Vrbias 0 50f

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point Analysis
op
let p_dc = -i(VDD) * 1.8
let id_ref = -i(Vindel)*0 + v(P001)/10000.0
print v(n2) v(Vrbias) v(VREF) id_ref p_dc

* 2. DC Sweep Analysis over Vindel
dc Vindel 0.3 0.8 0.01
meas dc id_mref_nom find id_ref at=0.8
meas dc v_n2_nom find v(n2) at=0.8
meas dc vrbias_nom find v(Vrbias) at=0.8

* 3. Supply Sensitivity Analysis over VDD
dc VDD 1.6 2.0 0.05
meas dc vrbias_vdd_low find v(Vrbias) at=1.6
meas dc vrbias_vdd_high find v(Vrbias) at=2.0
let supply_sens = (vrbias_vdd_high - vrbias_vdd_low) / 0.4
print supply_sens

* 4. AC Analysis for Error Amplifier
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let a_ol = vdb(Vrbias)
let a_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(Vrbias))
meas ac opamp_open_loop_gain find a_ol at=1k
meas ac opamp_unity_gain_frequency when a_ol=0 fall=1

print opamp_open_loop_gain opamp_unity_gain_frequency
quit
.endc
.end
